source_text: Key limitations stemmed from evidentiary and framing challenges: the resolution's categorical condemnation overlooked systematic reviews documenting net health benefits for neonatal male circumcision, including 50-60% reductions in heterosexual HIV acquisition and lower urinary tract infection risks in infancy.
